messages:
Lena (AE): Heads-up: BlueHarbor procurement is gating POC creds until we provide SOC2 artifacts, an ISO network diagram, a pen-test attestation, and an EU data residency statement. They want this before the SOW is signed. Can we move fast?
Tom (SE): I can pull the ISO diag and map. Quick Q: do they need the full SOC2 Type II PDF or just a bridge/summary?
Anya (Security): Full SOC2 available under NDA. We have a SOC2 bridge letter that summarizes controls and months covered. For pen-test attestation: we have two flavors — "internal red-team" note or "third-party assessment" wording. Procurement prefers third-party.
Marco (Legal): I can sign the third-party attestation. Need security to confirm the exact phrasing around "findings" and whether we say "remediated" vs "addressed". Also need the EU residency attestation text.
ops-bot: Provisioning note: Hosted POC staging creds can be provided in 48-72h with short-lived API keys. Dedicated/VPC peering with CMK requires 5-8 business days and separate quote. Pricing delta estimate: Dedicated +25-40% for a short reserved slice.
Lena (AE): BlueHarbor's SRE also wants to know whether we can provide customer-managed KMS for a POC in the EU region.
Anya (Security): CMK/HSM supported only on Dedicated in select regions. We can provide an attestation that keys are isolated when on Dedicated. For Hosted EU region, we provide data residency controls and encryption in transit/rest but not CMK.
Tom (SE): Action items: 1) Anya: drop final pen-test attestation text and SOC2 bridge letter. 2) Me: prep ISO network diagram with VPC peering callouts. 3) Marco: sign once Anya posts final wording. 4) Lena: get CIDR and NDA from BlueHarbor.
Lena (AE): Contact is kate@blueharbor.com. I'll request CIDR and confirm NDA for SOC2 PDF. Trying to keep staging creds to 72h if they accept Hosted constraints.
Anya (Security): Draft pen-test attestation (third-party wording):
```
Pen-test Attestation 3 Redwood Inference
- Customer: <BlueHarbor>
- Environment: staging/test tenant
- Scope: API endpoints, auth flows, selected integrations (see scope appendix)
- Assessment: Independent third-party assessment completed on <month/year>. High/critical findings were remediated or documented with compensating controls. Full report available upon execution of an NDA.
- Signatory: Authorized Legal signatory
```
Marco (Legal): That looks OK. Prefer "remediated or accepted with documented mitigations" for clarity. I'll sign once <month/year> is filled.
Tom (SE): Note re: EU residency attestation: we can provide a short statement confirming processing and storage of customer data for the POC will occur in eu-west-1 region and backups retained in-region. I'll draft the language.
Lena (AE): Perfect. BlueHarbor asked for an explicit line they can show procurement: "No production data will be transferred outside EU for the POC." Can we commit to that for Hosted EU region?
Anya (Security): For Hosted EU region for short-lived POCs we can commit not to transfer PII or customer production data outside EU; operationally we'll flag the tenant and avoid cross-region backups. We'll include that in the residency attestation.
ops-bot: Reminder: If BlueHarbor requests private link / dedicated VLAN, lead time + pricing apply. Hosted EU route is quickest but limited in some controls.
Lena (AE): Action list repeated: Anya post final attestation & SOC2 bridge; Tom upload ISO diagram; Marco pre-sign; I'll send NDA + CIDR request to Kate. Aim to ship creds in 72h if Hosted accepted. Thanks team :rocket:
